title: Which 'storm insurance' first at 24.8k: Infuser vs Diviner's Kevlar vs Unstoppable
question: At the slot after Superior Duration, which item keeps Seven alive longest and deals most during one storm against incoming spirit damage?
hypothesis: H-L3: Kevlar gives +23% storm damage per bot and absorbs 1000; Infuser +3% damage and ~1.8k heal per bot in the cloud; Unstoppable 0 damage. Prediction vs 3 bots and incoming spirit 350 dps: HP-lost Kevlar < Infuser only if heal per bot < ~0.6k (AoE lifesteal cut); otherwise Infuser lowest HP-lost, Kevlar highest damage.

setup.position: mid lane, bots on a 300 u ring (inside the 40 m storm)
setup.start_hp: lowhp 50 (heals never capped) (no lowhp: full HP; incoming spirit 350)

controls: Same position and spawn distance (enemies 3 at 300 u ring, main target 350 u)
hardreset between blocks (fresh cooldowns, no items)
Same souls/level/ability tiers (unlock 7) in every arm except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP keep-alive (ekeep 0.9) and resists
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
procedure: (INF) cast i1 0.1; cast 4 0.1; incoming spirit 350; wait 21; incoming off
(KEV/UNST) cast i1 0.1 where an active exists; same timing

metrics.name: hp_end
metrics.how: player HP at storm end (min over block)

decision.rule: higher hp_end with storm damage not lower by >10% wins the slot; the stun value of Unstoppable is outside this test
